snippet.title: Midnight Special: Early Access Release Trailer
snippet.description:
🎮Midnight Special: Early Access Coming on May 8, 2025!
👉Wishilist NOW for 20% Off during the first 14 days of release: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2560100?utm_source=youtube 
-
Step into a haunting point-and-click survival horror experience that pays homage to '70s and '80s cinema. Unravel the mysteries of Boyd Manor through atmospheric 16-bit pixel art and immersive storytelling.
-
🙌Follow Yahaha Games for more updates:
🔹 Official Website: http://www.yahaha.com/publisher
